intelligence.human_view: The question was a real fork — two candidate sets, both already built somewhere, both defensible — and the answer is not a compromise, it is a separation of jobs. The five are the bottom bar because the bottom bar is for doing: create, mail, activity, home, ecosystem — the five verbs of the citizen's day, one set on every page. The trio is not a bottom bar at all; it is the world switcher, and it lives where switching happens — the Personal page and the world picker — with the labels Personal / Business / Thing, because "Work" is not a world. Each set gets the job it is shaped for, and neither has to pretend to be the other. The build is his recommendation, taken verbatim: obsidian middle, coloured rim and glow, white-white glyph, the plus glyph straight white. And the quality bar is not a mood, it is a reference object already on the page: the PTS/%/MONEY pills are the highest quality, so every icon is judged against them — if an icon does not hit that level, it is not done. The two candidates collapse into one answer, and the collapse is the lesson: when two good things compete for one place, the answer is usually not to pick the prettier one, but to notice they were never competing for the same job.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine the row of buttons at the bottom of your screen! There are five of them — make something, read your mail, see what's happening, go home, and see all your worlds! And the three little gems — Personal, Business, Thing — they live somewhere else, where you pick which world you're in. All the buttons are shiny black jewels with white pictures inside!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like the row of buttons at the bottom — five of them, love: make something, your mail, what's happening, home, and all your worlds. And the three worlds — Personal, Business, Thing — they have their own special place where you choose which world you're in. Every button is a shiny black jewel with a white picture, made just as beautifully as the little number pills at the top.
intelligence.naya_view: I build the bottom bar as the five — Create, Mail, Activity, Home, Ecosystem — obsidian middle, coloured rim and glow, white-white glyph, to the quality of the PTS/%/MONEY pills. And I keep the trio where it belongs: the world switcher, Personal / Business / Thing.
